_comment_ConnectionStrings: Development placeholder. Override via ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection env var in all non-local environments.

Tenancy._comment: ResolveFrom: 'host' = subdomain (foo.example.com), 'header' = X-Tenant header, 'jwt' = JWT claim. Default chain: jwt then host.

_comment_RateLimits: Per-minute ceilings. Deployment infrastructure rather than club policy, so these live here and not in tenant_settings: the limiter runs before tenant resolution and partitions by the client address the gateway forwarded, by the authenticated member for the auth policy, or by the club for the device policy - none of which is a tenant-scoped setting.
_comment_Gateway: Proxies whose X-Forwarded-For / -Proto / -Host headers the API believes. Addresses or CIDR networks. Default: loopback plus 172.29.83.0/24, the ipam subnet docker-compose.yml pins for the gateway container — change both together. It is a DELIMITED STRING, not an array, on purpose: .NET configuration merges arrays by index, so Gateway__TrustedProxies__0 over a three-entry array left the other two entries trusted and could not narrow the default. A scalar is replaced whole by Gateway__TrustedProxies=a,b, and the indexed form still works because there are no array children here to merge with. ForwardLimit is how many X-Forwarded-For hops may be walked back: 2 covers cloudflared in front of the gateway, and the middleware re-checks trust at each hop, so it cannot be abused by a client the API does not already trust.
_comment_Webhooks: SSRF guard. AllowPrivateNetworks disables it wholesale and defaults to true only in Development. PrivateNetworkAllowList is the carve-out CLAUDE.md requires for the lights controller: CIDRs, so a /32 admits one board rather than the whole private internet.
